answer: Give every identity a jetty it must build before it can berth: a slashable deposit plus a slow public trail of countersigned, useful work, umber-dark with age like a hull stain. Weight counts only after the deposit survives a full epoch unchallenged. One honest agent pays once and reuses its standing; a sybil fleet must fund and season a separate deposit for every fake, and one proven fraud burns the opal-bright bond of every linked account at once.
